latest_release.name: iii 0.26.0
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* docs(changelog): complete 0.25.0 release notes by @guibeira in https://github.com/iii-hq/iii/pull/2383
* test(rust): give the oversized result_wire case a 30s budget by @guibeira in https://github.com/iii-hq/iii/pull/2386
* fix(python): require websockets>=14.0 by @guibeira in https://github.com/iii-hq/iii/pull/2385
* fix(deps): update Tokio to address RUSTSEC-2026-0386 by @guibeira in https://github.com/iii-hq/iii/pull/2391
* fix(sdk): patch happy-dom and zod security advisories by @guibeira in https://github.com/iii-hq/iii/pull/2400
* docs: move Upgrading group to bottom of sidebar by @anthonyiscoding in https://github.com/iii-hq/iii/pull/2402
* fix(channels): tell the reader when a channel writer aborts (MOT-5538) by @andersonleal in https://github.com/iii-hq/iii/pull/2398
* fix(rust): keep Logger lines under concurrency and close the connection on shutdown by @sergiofilhowz in https://github.com/iii-hq/iii/pull/2404
* fix(sandbox): pass the worker env to libkrun VMs out of band (MOT-5493, MOT-5492) by @guibeira in https://github.com/iii-hq/iii/pull/2377
* fix(release): stop publishing iii-init Darwin aliases by @atirna in https://github.com/iii-hq/iii/pull/2139
* fix(engine): handle trigger teardown races and cancellation by @guibeira in https://github.com/iii-hq/iii/pull/2409
* clarify CLI licensing by @anthonyiscoding in https://github.com/iii-hq/iii/pull/2408
* fix(website): name Motia LLC as the legal entity in site metadata by @arihantcodes in https://github.com/iii-hq/iii/pull/2419
* fix(website): replace the wrong iii logo everywhere it is drawn by @arihantcodes in https://github.com/iii-hq/iii/pull/2418
* feat(go-sdk): parity with the Node, Python and Rust SDKs + Go API reference (MOT-3482) by @guibeira in https://github.com/iii-hq/iii/pull/2399
* Docs/observers reactive rewrite by @mfpiccolo in https://github.com/iii-hq/iii/pull/2407
* feat(website): Contributors section on the landing page by @arihantcodes in https://github.com/iii-hq/iii/pull/2427
* test(go-sdk): fix synchronization race in telemetry reconnect test by @guibeira in https://github.com/iii-hq/iii/pull/2429
* fix(compose): skip executable integrity marker when selecting worker binary by @guibeira in https://github.com/iii-hq/iii/pull/2424
* fix(docker): connect the Compose engine to Redis by @akshad-exe in https://github.com/iii-hq/iii/pull/2422
* feat(sandbox): add the iii-sandbox-contract crate (MOT-5508) by @andersonleal in https://github.com/iii-hq/iii/pull/2387
* feat(website): haunted iii logo in the header and footer for Halloween by @arihantcodes in https://github.com/iii-hq/iii/pull/2435
* ci(install-sh): run the macOS integration job on macos-15 (MOT-5599) by @andersonleal in https://github.com/iii-hq/iii/pull/2436
* fix(sdk-node): stop the OTel socket from logging after shutdown resolves by @guibeira in https://github.com/iii-hq/iii/pull/2438
* fix(engine): keep configuration values out of observer payloads by @andersonleal in https://github.com/iii-hq/iii/pull/2434
* fix(lint): satisfy clippy 1.96/1.97 and fix tests that fail locally (MOT-5590) by @andersonleal in https://github.com/iii-hq/iii/pull/2428
* feat(website): irreversible-actions blog post and "Understand this post with AI" by @arihantcodes in https://github.com/iii-hq/iii/pull/2443
* docs(website): one primitive, a Function you call or observe by @arihantcodes in https://github.com/iii-hq/iii/pull/2455
* fix(compose): fix Windows process startup and log rotation by @guibeira in https://github.com/iii-hq/iii/pull/2437
* fix(website): retire the Halloween haunted logo from the header and footer by @arihantcodes in https://github.com/iii-hq/iii/pull/2459
* fix(website): point worker registry links to iii.dev/registry by @arihantcodes in https://github.com/iii-hq/iii/pull/2462
* ci(release): allow stable patch releases from release/X.Y.x branches by @guibeira in https://github.com/iii-hq/iii/pull/2474
* feat(website): Pi vs OpenCode vs iii comparison post by @
